labels.variantDefinition: A wall or grid of in-use mockups (posters, books, brochures, websites, signage) showing the font applied
labels.look: Black-and-white photographic mockups: brochures, event posters, record sleeve, website screenshot
labels.learn: Mockups in plausible cultural contexts (art centres, festivals) position the font's market

labels.variantDefinition: Several sample rows, each with its own style, size and leading controls
labels.look: Hot pink, letterspaced 'T E S T E R' heading, rows of huge display text with thin control rails
labels.ux: Each row: font size, leading, style select; editable text; Download Trials
labels.learn: Different defaults per row (titling vs text) show the family's range before anyone touches a control

labels.variantDefinition: Like hero/prop-collage: designed artefacts (UI windows, tickets, files, stickers) set in the font, collaged
labels.look: Sky-blue grid paper, design-tool windows with joke file names, flight ticket, stickers
labels.ux: Draggable/animated windows; a slider in one window
labels.learn: Joke file names ('…-v8-FINAL-final') speak directly to the designer audience

labels.variantDefinition: Every style named and shown on a short sample word, laid out in a grid
labels.look: Charcoal, white sample words in each weight with small weight labels
labels.feel: Fun, fandom (spells from Harry Potter and Star Wars)
labels.learn: Themed sample words (spells) make a dry weight list memorable

labels.variantDefinition: An OpenType feature or alternate shown off vs on (or default vs alternate), side by side or by toggle, with a short explanation
labels.look: White, grey 'off' line above the active line, feature tags [sups] [subs] [sinf], orange toggle dots
labels.learn: Show the same string with and without the feature, plus the tag, for every feature: a manual that is also a specimen

labels.variantDefinition: The whole character set in uniform grid cells, usually small, in encoding order
labels.look: White, thin-ruled cells, Latin, Greek and symbols
labels.learn: The completeness proof; pair it with something more expressive

labels.variantDefinition: Buying happens on the page: licence size picker, packages with prices, live preview text, add to cart
labels.look: Cream paper texture, rust-red section bars, licence-size cards, package list with prices
labels.ux: Pick licence size; type preview text that renders across packages; add to cart
labels.learn: Let the preview text flow into every package line, so you see what you are buying

labels.look: Black, Arabic words in pairs (default vs stylistic set), green dots, 'STYLISTIC SET 01–04' labels
labels.learn: Pairs, one per stylistic set, make subtle alternates visible in non-Latin scripts

labels.look: Dark grey, huge white condensed caps 'BAREHEADED, SHOVELING, WRECKING,'
labels.learn: A poem from the font's city as the stacked text roots the design in place
